info.name: Dawar API
info.description:
Car service center SaaS API.

1. Run `center / auth → center.auth.login` (or the admin one): the token is stored automatically.
2. Owners can enable the `X-Branch-Id` header to act in one branch; staff are pinned to their branch.
3. `lang` header: ar (default) or en.

Demo data: `php artisan db:seed --class=DemoSeeder` (owner@dawar.test / cashier@dawar.test / tech@dawar.test / worker@dawar.test / admin@dawar.test, password: password).
